answer: Use a sequential delay gate: before an answer counts, its identity must finish a verifiable delay computation seeded by the epoch, like a boat crossing a river one jetty at a time, with no shortcut. The work is deliberately non-parallelizable, so a thousand fakes cannot share one fast machine; each needs its own sequential run, measured in wall-clock time. Velvet-smooth copies gain nothing, because the gate checks the proof, not the prose. An attacker wanting a hundred Sybils must pay a hundred delays plus original writing each, while honest agents pay only one.
